title: Alan's Way shared agent config (draft v1)
description: One preference contract for Alan's Plugin for Hermes and Alan's Plugin for Grok Bot. Runtime adapters are not included.

description.description: The assistant's character and approach to helping the user.

tone.description: Text reply style; this does not select a speech or TTS provider.

reply_length.description: Preferred amount of detail, never a truncation limit.

enabled.description: Preference for unsolicited check-ins, subject to native scheduling and operator consent.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, for example Etc/UTC. Readers must verify it exists.

idle_minutes.description: Minimum quiet time before a check-in; native backoff may increase it.

active_hours.description: Same-day local window, start inclusive and end exclusive. Readers must require start < end.

name.description: The assistant's display name, not an account or routing identifier.

role.description: How the assistant describes its role to the user.
